text_block_list.text:
One day, as summer training camp
was approaching its climax—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Flash-saaan☆
Fouuund you!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Falcon-san...?
Running over energetically was Eishin Flash's roommate and Umadol(?), Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Were you looking for me?
Did you need something?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Ehe☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —I portioned out 25 ml of tail treatment for you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yay, thank you☆
Now my hair's gonna be silky smooth~!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I believe I reminded you twice
to double-check your luggage before the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Because~ I figured Flash-san would definitely bring one, so it'd be fine~☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I mean, are you sure you don't wanna shower together?
It's getting pretty late, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, I haven't finished my schedule yet.
I still have 15 minutes... no, 20 minutes including travel time
of routines left to complete.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!?
That's just a margin of error!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Listen closely, Falcon-san.
I can overlook a five-minute discrepancy.
However, with twenty minutes—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"There it is! Flash-san's
'Difficult Words and Concepts' Attack~!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I haven't used any difficult words yet, though...
Eishin Flash appeared to show her emotions more openly than usual. It seemed she could truly let her guard down around her.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, let's head back.
Finally, we have your feedback for today,
followed by a review of the schedule from tomorrow onward."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that looks complicated~...
Can't you just do it tomorrow~?

"Eishin Flash is growing steadily stronger.
To encourage further growth from here, a new
perspective will likely be needed."
Furthermore, if there's a way to let her unwind at the same time, given how overly tense she's been since day one of camp...
choice_data_list: I want you to help Smart Falcon

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
To Falco? What is it?
choice_data_list: Tell me the secret to building power.
Teach me the trick to hanging on till the very end.

text_block_list.text:
On dirt tracks, Smart Falcon's main battlefield, power is essential.
I told her I wanted to know how she trains for it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, there is much to learn
from Falcon-san's strength.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
She often dances in her dorm room too,
constantly bumping into things on her desk.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Is that... a compliment?
Hmm, but the secret to bringing out power, huh...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —That's it☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Mmh~♪
The cotton candy was yummy, wasn't it☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
What should we eat next?
Mizuame? Candy apples? They're all so cute☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Um. You're going to teach me
the secret to putting out more power, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Why are we strolling through a summer festival and eating stall desserts?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Charging up my energy with swee~t treats☆
This is the secret to Falco's powerfulness♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Is there one?
choice_data_list: Give it a shot and just have fun!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"How can you enjoy it if you just take a leap of faith?
If you can't even show why it's effective in the first place—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yep, no difficult words or conceptual attacks allowed☆
Let's go, let's go!

Eishin Flash looked suspicious at first.
However, near the end, she certainly seemed to have recharged her power.
Smart Falcon often employs a dynamic Front Runner strategy. I was curious how she manages to hold on to the lead with such tenacity.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Falcon-san's
tenacity is truly astonishing."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Even at riverbank concerts, if there's even one more person in the audience, you add another song even when it's time to pack up, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe☆
That's something Falco gets praised for a lot!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You know, the reason Falco can work this hard is—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—L-O-V-E!
Love☆Falco! Ready?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Love☆Falco—!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible. Falcon-san has been
dancing non-stop for a whole hour now...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As long as my fans are watching...☆
Falco can keep giving it her all forever!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Today's fan is Flash-san!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for telling me about what happened by the riverbank earlier.
Thank you for always watching over me~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Filled with all my gratitude☆
Let's turn up the hype even more~!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Feelings. A vague concept, but
when demonstrated so clearly, I have no choice but to accept it."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...She truly is an incredible person...

Eishin Flash's voice sounded
somehow gentle as she murmured that...
